reason: The hypothesis relies on UFG-enhanced Cr diffusion and a subsequent oxidation step to improve passivation, but the cited evidence (E3, E5) explicitly states that UFG formation by HPT has little impact on passivation and corrosion resistance in HEAs, directly contradicting the premise that UFG alone promotes beneficial Cr diffusion. The other cited passages (E1, E2, E4) discuss unrelated topics (wear in vacuum, Al-HEA oxide damage, high-entropy effects suppressing selective dissolution) and provide no support for the proposed dual-step mechanism in stainless steels.
